label: AF3 code + Anthropic kit `big` + OpenFold3 preview-2 weights, no templates, A100
notes: kit `big`: fast's levers minus the memory-hungry ones (FPF_TRIMUL, FPF_HOIST, HOIST_LOGITS, ATOM_COND_HOIST, TRIMUL_CD off) -- the kit's lowest-peak-memory mode
Anthropic's af3_jax optimization kit (github.com/anthropics/uplifting-biomolecular-modeling, Apache-2.0,
reference release 2026-09-17, not maintained) on the AlphaFold 3 JAX codebase, with the OpenFold3 PREVIEW-2
weights the kit pins (of3-p2-155k -> of3_ported_weights.bin.zst by the fork's converter; sha256 in the kit's
stock/PINS.json).
engine stays `af3`: same codebase, same af3_pool inputs, same log timers as af3_openbind_templateoff_a100.
Only the launcher differs: launcher.kind af3_jax_kit runs `run.sh pred --mode M` inside the kit's OWN container
image (launcher.image; override with AF3OF3_KIT_IMAGE). The image is the kit's environment/Dockerfile built
unchanged except for dropping an optional pre-filled compile cache, by the 'kit image' GitHub Action of the fork
juliabuhmann/uplifting-biomolecular-modeling at c8a1147 (upstream release f4f62fa), pushed to
ghcr.io/juliabuhmann/af3_jax-kit:c8a1147 and pulled with `apptainer build`. It carries the stock venv, the kit venv and the pinned checkout,
so the host builds nothing; the earlier venv route (GLIBCXX and libcifpp workarounds) is gone.
Smoke-tested 2026-09-22 on eu-ts-01 (A100): off and exact gave the same ipTM on one pair, both 5/5 predictions.
PEAK MEMORY: a kit mode runs the model in a child process that profiling/peak_mem.py cannot wrap, so
run_with_trace.py reads the kit's own `PEAK-NOTE ... peak_alloc_gib=` line -- jax peak_bytes_in_use, the
same counter peak_mem.py reads for the af3 engine, so the column is comparable across arms.
--cache_dir: the sweep passes ONE node-local cache to every arm and size (as for af3_openbind_*). The kit's
own `off` would run with an empty --cache_dir; a caller's flag rides last and wins, so here off is stock
with the same warm compile cache as the other arms -- comparable within this sweep, not the kit's own off.
The kit's compile-cache root (AF3_JAX_CACHE_ROOT) is node-local scratch too: the image's /opt/jit_cache is empty.
Every kit mode pays a one-time tokamax autotune attempt per PROCESS (~20 s, the kit's README) that stock
does not; one size per process here, so small sizes are biased against the kit and 5,000 tokens by <3 %.
Exit 3 with `DONE status=partial ... levers_short=`: every prediction written but a lever engaged nowhere for
this input; run_with_trace.py records that run as ok (the kit's documented meaning of that code).
Card: A100 80GB (cc 8.0), which the kit ships a card file for. The kit's headline numbers are H100;
on A100 its README says big leaves the fused triangle attention and fused transition off.
OpenBind on this kit needs profiling/patches/af3_jax_openbind.diff (4 files, gated on of3_openbind); the image
does not carry it, and these arms run preview-2 on purpose, so the kit is measured as shipped first.
The mode meant for the sizes fast cannot fit; whether it reaches the production scheme's 5,120 tokens on 80 GB, and at what speed relative to off, is what this arm measures.
